changes.text_diff:
@@ -1,7 +1,7 @@
 Invoke a skill.
 
 A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow).
-Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions.
+Available skills appear in a listing from the system with one-line descriptions.
 When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result.
 A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime.
 Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

changes.title: additionalMarketplaces.<name>.pluginDigests description changed (+220 −1106 chars)
changes.text_diff:
@@ -1,8 +1,1 @@
-Managed settings only: the plugins of this marketplace that an organization delivers with its own tier, by plugin name, each with the digests of its releases.
-A plugin also enabled and listed in prependPlugins or appendPlugins by managed settings the session vouches for loads its hooks module only from a folder that proves one of them, and is then seated in that tier; any other copy does not load.
-A digest is sha256- and the base64 SHA-256 of, for every regular file in the folder in UTF-16 code unit order of its path, not normalized, "f PATH" NUL BYTE-LENGTH NUL BYTES, with / in paths; .git, .in_use, .orphaned_at, .claude-plugin-link and .links_materialized at the root are left out.
-The plugin keeps its manifest at .claude-plugin/plugin.json and names one module in hooks/hooks.json.
-A string of any other form, or a list that is empty or of any other shape, matches no folder.
-A symbolic link, or a surface module, proves nothing.
-A proved plugin ships bundled with no install step: the digest covers the whole folder, node_modules included.
-A checkout whose line endings were converted proves nothing.
+Deprecated and ignored: settings that hold it still load. A plugin takes the organization tier when managed settings enable it, declare its marketplace with a remote source and list it in prependPlugins or appendPlugins.

changes.title: additionalMarketplaces.<name>.source.package description changed (+218 −311 chars)
changes.text_diff:
@@ -1,3 +1,1 @@
-npm package containing marketplace.json (e.g.
-"@acme/claude-marketplace").
